question: Does fitting the established six-scalar contextual response Gram across both v15 tense directions remove the earlier parity confound and route capability-qualified v16 without refitting?

prior_art.known_lessons: The six-scalar Gram router is perfect in one held direction and leaks four rows in the other when trained on only the reversed direction. Raw high-dimensional ridge memorizes direction. Tied embeddings fail v15 control selectivity and default all v16 targets off. The rank-two contextual responses and their direct residual decoder are causally validated.
prior_art.novelty: Fit one fixed six-scalar centroid router on cross-fitted contextual responses from both v15 directions, use leave-one-group-out rather than parity holdout for its in-distribution falsifier, and apply it to v16 under each of the two independently trained oracle bases. No optimizer or new feature is added.

frozen_design.features: For proposed A1/A2 entry12 deltas, use the existing semantic-token and prefix Gram triples: log mean-square A1, log mean-square A2, and mean A1-A2 inner product at each scope. Responses for each v15 row use the oracle trained on the opposite parity. V16 is evaluated twice, once under each frozen oracle fold.
frozen_design.fit: Fit one z-scored cosine-nearest-centroid A1/A2/off router on all v15 rows only. Before the final fit, score deterministic leave-one-group-out predictions over all 16 lexical groups. Off pools P and C on v15. There are no thresholds, regularization choices, label gains, logits, or v16 selection.
frozen_design.ood_scope: Score aligned capability-qualified v16 A1/A2/P; explicitly exclude variable-length C. Require both frozen oracle-coordinate systems to pass and agree exactly.
frozen_design.controls: Bind all builders, helpers, oracle, capability and parent-null hashes; validate row hashes/alignment, v15/v16 disjoint IDs, finite values, class inventories, two oracle coordinate executions, exact execution counts, and zero updates/backwards.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_scope_finiten: All bound authorities, exact row hashes, alignment and v16 C exclusion, disjoint row IDs, finite features, class inventories, and exact literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_v15_leave_one_group_out_is_select: Pooled v15 leave-one-group-out macro accuracy is >=.95 with zero P/C rows predicted A1/A2.
predictions.pred_c_v16_generalizes_under_both_oracle: Each oracle fold has v16 macro accuracy >=.75 and zero P rows predicted target.
predictions.pred_d_each_v16_target_is_covered: Each oracle fold correctly routes at least 12/16 A1 rows and 12/16 A2 rows.
predictions.pred_e_oracle_folds_agree_on_v16: The two independently frozen oracle-coordinate systems make identical predictions on all 48 scored v16 rows.

decision: A failure invalidates. A/B/C/D/E licenses a separately registered causal v16 execution of the existing rank-two state program. B failure closes this contextual Gram route in distribution. B pass with C/D/E failure is an OOD identification null and forbids v16 threshold or regularization tuning.
